reviewItem.question: Does "Patch the `third_party/forked/acme` package with support for the ACME profiles extension" mean a change to protocol-behavior:cert-manager|name=acme-profiles-extension (added)?

proposed.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 patches its internal third_party/forked/acme package to support the ACME profiles extension; this is listed as a cleanup item with no stated effect on operators.
